comment:
* Sit in a loop and handle incoming udp datagram messages. For each Datagram * packet, a new UDPMessageChannel is created (upto the max thread pool size). * Each UDP message is processed in its own thread). * * @version 1.2 $Revision: 1.37 $ $Date: 2009/11/14 20:06:16 $ * * @author M. Ranganathan
* * * * * See the implementation sequence diagram for processing incoming requests. * * * * Acknowledgement: Jeff Keyser contributed ideas on starting and stoppping the * stack that were incorporated into this code. Niklas Uhrberg suggested that * thread pooling be added to limit the number of threads and improve * performance.

variables.name: port
variables.comment: * The Mapped port (in case STUN suport is enabled)

variables.name: messageChannels
variables.comment: * A list of message channels that we have started.

variables.name: isRunning
variables.comment:
* A flag that is set to false to exit the message processor (suggestion by
     * Jeff Keyser).

methods.name: public int getPort()
methods.comment:
* Get port on which to listen for incoming stuff.
     *
     * @return port on which I am listening.

methods.name: public void stop()
methods.comment:
* Shut down the message processor. Close the socket for recieving incoming
     * messages.

methods.name: public String getTransport()
methods.comment:

     * @return the transport string

methods.comment:
